context_card.cerita: Raka sedang live di ruang tamu saat listrik padam sebentar pukul 20.00. Begitu lampu menyala, HP-nya hilang dari tripod dan sudah dibawa keluar dari ruang tamu. Salah satu tersangka berbohong.

clue_awal.teks: Pak Tono selalu membungkus barang temuan dengan kantong kresek, lalu menyimpannya di pos jaga.

pengakuan.teks: Aku tidak menyentuh toples apa pun malam ini.
Aku tidak membawa apa-apa ke dapur sejak magrib.
Malam ini tidak ada barang temuan di pos jaga.
Aku sudah pulang sebelum listrik padam.

rt_kursi.teks: Laptop Raka di kursi mustard memutar ulang live-nya. Detik terakhir, dalam remang: HP dimasukkan ke toples kaca.

rt_meja.teks: Tripod HP di meja kopi lengket. Bekas tangan yang mencabut HP itu berbau bawang merah.

rt_rak.teks: Catatan Nenek di rak buku: "Barang yang dipinjam Hendra selalu berakhir di meja Ruang Kerja."

rt_lemari.teks: Kunci gembok Ruang Kerja ada di lemari kecil ini. Ruang Kerja terkunci sejak magrib.

rt_telepon.teks: Raka menelepon HP-nya dari telepon rumah. Deringnya terdengar samar dari arah dapur.

rt_keset.teks: Sepasang sandal jepit tipis tergeletak miring di depan rak sepatu, seperti ditinggal buru-buru.

rt_jam.teks: Jamnya sempat mati waktu listrik padam. Sekarang terlambat lima menit.

rt_foto.teks: Raka tidak ada di foto keluarga ini. Ia datang dua tahun setelahnya.

rt_lukisan.teks: Lukisannya sedikit berdebu. Tidak ada apa-apa di baliknya.

rt_sofa.teks: Bantal sofa penyok bekas diduduki Raka berjam-jam.

rt_kolong.teks: Kolong sofa: kabel charger putus dan satu koin lima ratus.

rt_tirai.teks: Lampu ring Raka bersandar di balik tirai, padam dan sedih.

teks_kosong_bawaan: Tidak ada yang aneh di sini.

penjelasan.teks: Pelakunya bertangan kanan, jadi bukan Bu Wati.
Rekaman live menunjukkan HP dimasukkan ke toples kaca. Pak Tono selalu memakai kresek, jadi bukan dia.
Dering HP terdengar dari arah dapur.
Barang pinjaman Om Hendra selalu berakhir di Ruang Kerja, bukan di dapur. Pelakunya Mbok Sri, cocok dengan tangan berbau bawang.
Mbok Sri mengaku tidak membawa apa-apa ke dapur, padahal dering HP terdengar dari sana. Dialah yang berbohong.

komentar_nenek: Sri, Nenek paham kamu bosan direkam terus waktu masak. Tapi toples kerupuk itu bukan brankas.

en.cerita: Raka was livestreaming in the living room when the power went out briefly at 8:00 p.m. When the lights came back, his phone was gone from the tripod and had already been carried out of the living room. One of the suspects is lying.

clue_awal.A2: Mr. Tono always wraps found items in a plastic bag, then keeps them at the guard post.

pengakuan.P1: I didn't touch any jar tonight.
pengakuan.P2: I didn't take anything to the kitchen since sunset.
pengakuan.P3: There were no found items at the guard post tonight.
pengakuan.P4: I'd already gone home before the power went out.

benda.rt_kursi: Raka's laptop on the mustard armchair is replaying his stream. The last second, in the dim light: the phone being put into a glass jar.
benda.rt_meja: The phone tripod on the coffee table is sticky. The hand that pulled the phone off it smelled of onions.
benda.rt_rak: Grandma's note on the bookshelf: "Anything Hendra borrows always ends up on the Study desk."
benda.rt_lemari: The key to the Study padlock is in this small cabinet. The Study has been locked since sunset.
benda.rt_telepon: Raka calls his phone from the house phone. The ringing is faintly heard from the direction of the kitchen.
benda.rt_keset: A pair of thin flip-flops lies crooked in front of the shoe rack, as if left in a hurry.
benda.rt_jam: The clock stopped when the power went out. Now it's five minutes slow.
benda.rt_foto: Raka isn't in this family photo. He arrived two years later.
benda.rt_lukisan: The painting is a little dusty. There's nothing behind it.
benda.rt_sofa: The sofa cushions are flattened from Raka sitting on them for hours.
benda.rt_kolong: Under the sofa: a broken charging cable and a 500-rupiah coin.
benda.rt_tirai: Raka's ring light leans behind the curtain, switched off and sad.

penjelasan: The culprit is right-handed, so it's not Mrs. Wati.
The stream shows the phone being put into a glass jar. Mr. Tono always uses a plastic bag, so it wasn't him.
The phone was heard ringing from the kitchen.
Things Uncle Hendra borrows always end up in the Study, not the kitchen. The culprit is Mbok Sri, which matches the hand that smelled of onions.
Mbok Sri said she didn't take anything to the kitchen, yet the phone was ringing in there. She's the one who lied.
en.komentar_nenek: Sri, Grandma understands you're tired of being filmed while you cook. But the cracker jar is not a safe.
